steps.observation: Name three causes of World War I.

steps.action:
1. Militarism: European powers engaged in an arms race, expanding their armies and navies, which made diplomatic solutions more difficult.  
2. Alliance system: Two major blocs (the Triple Entente of France, Russia, Britain and the Triple Alliance of Germany, Austria-Hungary, Italy) committed members to defend one another, so a localized conflict threatened to drag in all.  
3. Nationalism: Intense patriotic fervor and ethnic self-determination movements—especially in the Balkans—fueled rivalries and made compromise less likely.
